verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements layer, so automatic sales tax, VAT, and GST calculation and collection is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions tax calculation, tax rates, VAT/GST handling, or tax collection. The previewAttach endpoint only shows what customers will be charged, which is adjacent at best and is not tax-specific.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically
